apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(detail): wire the completed and dropped buttons (`a226f4d1`)
- feat(player): enlarge desktop overlay by 25% (`beeae551`)
- fix(watch): size the chat field and add the send icon (`71be8cb4`)
- fix(player): deliver typed text from overlay fields (`5d61dfa8`)
- fix(watch): publish the selected content and show the watch button to guests (`332d6447`)
- fix(watch): resend the shared stream to late joiners (`f4a02eb9`)
- fix(watch): open the Nuvio realtime channel with the gate parameter (`63a496d1`)
- feat(player): add a watch together button to the player controls (`88f6d9ad`)
- fix(watch): route watch panel actions while the player is open (`e73df81d`)
- feat(addons): take trailers from catalog-less meta addons (`e81ba7f8`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.15...v0.3.16
